title: positions: carry renamedFrom holders on a hot package install or upgrade too, not only at kernel boot
body:
repo:hotcrm#1 · huangyiirene · session_01J8VVAnPkgK6CWrJa6t7Fk5

## Source

Out-of-scope finding from HotCRM card objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2458 (PR hotcrm#2459), reported by its dev thread. HotCRM 6.2.0 renamed twelve positions. 6.2.1 declares `renamedFrom` on each, so their holders follow (#33008).

## The gap (measured on @objectstack 18.4.0)

- The `renamedFrom` carry runs only at `kernel:bootstrapped`.
- A hot package install or upgrade, such as a marketplace upgrade on a running environment, registers the renamed positions without moving their holders. Until the environment restarts, each holder of an old name holds a position that no longer exists.
- Nothing reports it, and every permission set and sharing rule the position gave is lost silently.
- Measured on staging by the director (hotcrm#2458): after a 6.1.2 → 6.2.0 upgrade, a `sales_manager` member's access fell from 32/23/8 rows to 1/0/403.

## What would close it

Run the same holder carry when a package install or upgrade registers positions, not only at boot. The operation is already idempotent, since once a holder has moved there is nothing left to move.

## hotcrm half

6.2.1 documents that holders move at the environment's next start. The hosted upgrade of `huayan` will restart after installing 6.2.1.
